Fibocom Wireless Inc. has called a third extraordinary general meeting for September 28, 2026 in Shenzhen to seek shareholder approval for a series of share incentive and award plans covering both its A shares and H shares. The agenda includes special resolutions to adopt a new 2026 A-share restricted share incentive plan and H-share share award plan, set evaluation and management measures, authorize the board to implement these schemes, and cancel remaining treasury shares under the A-share plan, underscoring the company’s emphasis on equity-based compensation.

An additional ordinary resolution will ask shareholders to approve applications for new bank credit facilities, which could support operational funding, investment or expansion alongside the revised incentive structures. Detailed voting, proxy, and registration procedures have been laid out for Hong Kong H-share investors, highlighting governance formalities as the company moves to refine its capital structure and strengthen board flexibility in managing both employee incentives and financing arrangements.

data.title: Shenzhen Senior Tech Material Calls EGM to Approve Equity Acquisition
data.description:
Shenzhen Senior Technology Material Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6067) ) has shared an announcement.

Shenzhen Senior Technology Material Co., Ltd. has called a sixth extraordinary general meeting for 23 September 2026 in Shenzhen to seek shareholder approval for an external investment to acquire equity interests in a target company, via proposed equity transfer agreements. The meeting arrangements, including H share register closure, proxy procedures and poll-based voting, underline formal governance and shareholder participation in a transaction that could reshape the company’s investment portfolio and strategic positioning.

Holders of H shares on the register as of 23 September 2026 will be eligible to attend and vote at the extraordinary general meeting, provided their share transfers are completed by 17 September 2026. The company has detailed identification, proxy and logistical requirements for attending the meeting, reinforcing transparency and regulatory compliance as it moves to secure shareholder backing for the planned equity acquisition.

data.title: Great China Holdings Clarifies Board and Committee Structure
data.description:
The latest update is out from Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited ( (HK:0021) ).

Great China Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited has disclosed an updated list of its directors and clarified their respective roles and functions on the board. The structure comprises one executive director serving as chairman, one non-executive director, and three independent non-executive directors, underscoring an emphasis on balanced oversight.

The company has also detailed the composition of its three key board committees: audit, remuneration, and nomination. Independent director Cheng Hong Kei chairs all three committees, while the other independent directors and the chairman serve as members, highlighting a governance framework that concentrates committee leadership in independent board members.
